SHA-256 by Stephan Brumme (http://create.stephan-brumme.com/hash-library/), zlib license (see
LICENSE), in the version altered for Xenia. Copied unchanged from the ReXGlue SDK
(`thirdparty/crypto/sha256.{h,cpp}`, last changed there in commit `df2743b`), which uses it but does
not install it. Used by `src/save_import` for the SHA-256 at the end of the Xbox 360 saves.
